signals.text: 1 open PM role across 2 US offices

roles.title: Senior Product Manager, Commercial Real Estate
roles.location: New York, New York, United States, San Francisco, California, United States

bullets: Own major product features from discovery through release
Meet directly with enterprise real estate investors to find problems and test solutions. We have no separate UX research team, so discovery is yours.
Turn account signals (gross and net retention, upsell, seat expansion) into a prioritized roadmap
Build your own prototypes and shape solutions with AI, working with design and engineering
Shape product culture through clear decisions and hands-on ownership
